parsed.rationale: All four participating records are exact-duplicate `data` method implementations on identically-named `SequentialMockSession` inner types nested inside three distinct test-suite classes (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests`) within the single file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` in the `Artwork` package. Although the context flags report `is_test: false` (likely a pipeline classification gap given the file path ends in `Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`), the structural evidence is unambiguous: the same `SequentialMockSession.data` method body is copy-pasted four times across three test classes. The correct fix is to hoist `SequentialMockSession` into a single shared helper type at the top of `ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` (or a dedicated `TestHelpers` file within the same test target), removing the three redundant inner-type definitions and letting all test classes reference the shared one.
